Notes from LENS seminars, by members first and invited speakers later. Each talk gets a short
page covering:

- the research problem and its motivating application;
- how identifiability, recoverability, or related concepts come up;
- the terminology and frameworks the speaker uses;
- connections to other areas in LENS;
- open questions.

Tag each page with the concepts it touches (its `categories`) so the concept pages can link
back, and copy new questions to [Open problems](../open-problems.qmd). To add one, copy
`seminars/_template.qmd` to `seminars/YYYY-MM-DD-speaker.qmd`.

*No seminars recorded yet.*
